title: Nintendo Switch 2 ships the desktop DLSS models including DLSS 4 (not 4.5) plus two new lighter presets, per a data miner
label: تسريب

sources.name: data miner's post on X, 16 Nov 07:24 Dubai (not named or linked in our posts, by Mohammad's choice)

gate: gate 13:2xZ: searched for a denial or correction (VideoCardz, Notebookcheck, news search); none found; no Nintendo or NVIDIA statement

angle.hook: Switch 2 carries the same DLSS as PC, DLSS 4 included, per a data miner
angle.why_now: the dump was posted this morning, 16 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: DLSS renders the game at a lower resolution and sharpens it with AI; heavy and light versions let each studio choose a sharper picture or a faster game
angle.payoff: Nintendo and NVIDIA have not confirmed it

footage: Nintendo's own Switch 2 product clips from nintendo.com (Joy-Con 2 attach, TV mode montage, Switch 2 logo); no NVIDIA video outside YouTube

director_sendbacks.note: Line 4 (فيختار المطور لكل لعبة / بين صورة أدق وأداء أسرع) sits on the white SWITCH wordmark of the red logo shot (16.5 to 20 s) and its second half is unreadable; end line 4 on the forest shot and make the logo shot picture-only, or replace the logo shot with another Switch 2 product shot
